name: sparx — Office Supply (B2B / Wholesale)
tagline: A wholesale storefront built for trade buyers.
description: A complete, working wholesale shop for a workplace-supplies distributor: a real trade catalogue sold by the box and case — paper & ink, writing, furniture and breakroom supplies — with categories, collections, a bespoke trade PDP (per-box pricing, volume breaks, net-30), and a full merchandised home page. Clean corporate theme — cool slate ground, confident blue, teal accent. Shipped as Worksmith Supply Co.
